profile.headline: Contract Full-Stack Developer @ Ally
profile.summary:
Hi there! I’m a full-stack software engineer from Detroit, Michigan, who loves blending creativity and technology. With a background in art and design, I bring a unique perspective to software development. I enjoy combining technical know-how with creative thinking to come up with fresh, innovative solutions to all kinds of challenges.

My skillset includes:

Languages | JavaScript, Java, HTML, CSS, Python
Libraries and Frameworks | React, Node.js, Express.js, Vue, Angular, Spring boot, Hapi.js, Jest, Mocha, Chai
Database | PostgreSQL, Sequelize, Oracle, ORM, MongoDB, Mongoose, ODM
Deployment | Git, Github, Bitbucket, Heroku, Netlify
Other | REST APIs, Amazon S3, Agile, Figma, Docker, Tailwind, CI/CD

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description: Skills: AngularJS · Spring Boot · Java · Oracle Database

positions.title: Software Engineer Volunteer
positions.description:
-Built and maintained several components of the demo version of the hs.credit app with React and PostgreSQL. Full demo was delivered on-time according to the deadline.
-Oversee front-end work and contribute to development of MVP version of app.
-Provide guidance and feedback to interns. Co-conduct sprint plannings and development syncs to give and receive feedback from other developers. 
-Contribute to key organizational conversations on app design, functionality, target audience, goals, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Jest · Representational State Transfer (REST) · SASS · Software Development · Model-View-Controller (MVC) · Agile Methodologies · HTML · Communication · Teamwork · Unit Testing · REST APIs · Databases · Agile Application Development · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Support projects from design to implementation
-Built and maintained small sections of the customer dashboard and product API. This included building small API endpoints, addressing customer facing bugs, navigating through the database with SQL queries, working with and updating company’s custom component library. Working with Vue.js.
-Wrote thorough tests using tools like Vitest, Jest, Sinon, Chai and Mocha. Manually tested code in development, staging and production environments.
-Delivered quality work aligned with company branding goals and team norms per the Projects managers and design team requirements.
-Active and participating member of Womxn & Non-Binary engineers group.

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description:
- Essential Worker. Maintain store cleanliness, regulate customer entry, enforce safety protocols during a global pandemic. 
- Complete time-sensitive tasks such as stocking morning deliveries, and afternoon restocks in a fast-paced environment, ensuring product availability, and customer/team safety hourly. - - Multitask, handling cash and product efficiently while maintaining Trader Joe’s excellent reputation with friendly conversation.

positions.title: Software Engineering Fellow
positions.description: Built 4 projects in a 12 week span, using several different languages and frame works. A few being:  Javascript, Python, React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQl and MongoDB

positions.title: Cashier Supervisor
positions.description:
- Trained new employees monthly on POS systems, customer service and product knowledge. 
- Maintained customer relationships, upholding a strong reputation for customer service and communication.
- Handled large amounts of cash daily. Supervised 6 cashiers during the day and 2 nightly closing cashiers’ cash count, ensuring accuracy at end of day.
